title: UNM Health cybersecurity event interrupts patient care
text: UNM confirmed a cybersecurity event on October 26 in Albuquerque, New Mexico. It temporarily limited new patients and suspended outpatient surgeries and appointments. Law enforcement and external investigators were engaged. Hospitals were open and clinics were scheduled to resume October 27. The exact mechanism and full scope remained under investigation.

title: Ahold Delhaize confirms malicious activity and grocery service disruption
text: Ahold Delhaize confirmed malicious activity behind the October 12 cybersecurity incident. Containment shutdowns affected websites and apps across most brands in Europe and the United States. Grocery home deliveries and e-commerce were being restored in stages, including the Netherlands and Belgium. Stores remained open. The company had no evidence of sensitive data theft at the time of the October 19 statement.

title: CERT-FR confirms compromises of refrigeration controllers
text: CERT-FR's October 12 alert, updated October 16, confirms numerous compromises of remote refrigeration controllers, including Danfoss AK-SM and AK-SC and Copeland/Dixell xweb. The agency advises checking defrost settings, removing exposed management interfaces, and recovering compromised equipment. The alert does not establish attacker identity or precise victim counts.

title: Magento CMS block loader campaign compromises 953 online stores
text: Sansec documented a criminal campaign compromising 953 stores since July 2025, mostly Magento stores. The current deepveindrilling loader appeared at 83 stores in October 2026, including previously compromised sites. Researchers observed unauthorized database changes and persistence. The latest final payload had not been captured; payment theft should not be assumed. The victims' countries were not specified.

title: Gheist campaign abuses compromised GitHub accounts and steals cloud secrets
text: Wiz has tracked Gheist since September 15, 2026. It found more than 13500 planted branches across more than 850 compromised GitHub accounts. Researchers confirmed successful workflow execution and follow-on activity in private repositories and enterprise environments, including use of cloud credentials. Public repository safeguards blocked observed executions there. Victim locations were not specified.

title: iRhythm confirms patient information stolen from third-party systems
text: iRhythm confirmed unauthorized access and downloading of patient data in third-party-hosted business applications between June 3 and June 8, 2026. Its October 2 notice describes patient contacts, account identifiers, device serial numbers, insurance numbers, service dates and birth dates. Notification began October 2. No evidence of identity theft was reported. The company statement is datelined San Francisco.

title: Genesys confirms unauthorized access to internal CRM and learning systems
text: Genesys detected unauthorized access to internal business systems on October 16 and confirmed information accessed or downloaded from CRM and learning-management systems. This included business and customer-contact information. Its October 23 update says the incident was contained. Genesys production cloud/contact-center platforms and customer environments were not compromised. The scope of affected internal information remained under review.
